FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) ACT 1984

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) (COLLECTION OF TOLLS)

(AMPANG−KUALA LUMPUR ELEVATED HIGHWAY) (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2015

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 2 of the Federal Roads (Private

Management) Act 1984 [Act 306], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Private Management)

(Collection of Tolls) (Ampang−Kuala Lumpur Elevated Highway) (Amendment)

Order 2015.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 15 October 2015.

Substitution of First Schedule

2. The Federal Roads (Private Management) (Collection of Tolls) (Ampang−Kuala

Lumpur Elevated Highway) Order 2001 [P.U. (A) 166/2001], is amended by substituting

for the First Schedule the following Schedule:

"FIRST SCHEDULE

[subparagraph 2(1)]

RATES OF TOLL

(1)

Classes of Vehicle

(2)

Toll Payable

(RM)

1. Vehicle having two axles and three or four wheels

(excluding taxi and bus)

2.50

7.00

10.50

1.80

1.50

2. Vehicle having two axles and five or six wheels

(excluding bus)

3. Vehicle having three axles or more (excluding bus)

4. Taxi

5. Bus

For the purpose of calculating the number of axles and wheels of a vehicle, the axles and

wheels of any trailer towed by the vehicle shall be calculated as part of the axles and

wheels of the vehicle.".

Made 12 October 2015

[KKR.PUU.110-1/7/15; PN(PU2)426/LX]

DATO' SRI HAJI FADILLAH BIN HAJI YUSOF

Minister of Works
